card.name: The "or" inside fluorouracil and oritavancin
card.fires_on: The piece "or" in the middle of a drug name, mainly after "5-Flu" in 5-fluorouracil. It also fires on "or" that starts "oritavancin" after "other".

modes.label: Inside fluorouracil
modes.description: The "or" that follows "Flu" in 5-fluorouracil, usually in chemotherapy regimens.

modes.label: Start of oritavancin
modes.description: The "or" after "other" that begins "oritavancin" in cross-references between ORBACTIV and KIMYRSA labels.
